# anecdotes_control_categories (Data Source)

Lists all control categories in the Anecdotes account, with optional filtering by framework or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anecdotes_control_categories" "soc2" {
  framework_id = "fw_12345"
}

output "categories" {
  value = data.anecdotes_control_categories.soc2.categories
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `framework_id` (String) Filter categories by framework ID.
- `name_contains` (String) Filter categories whose name contains this substring (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `categories` (Attributes List) List of control categories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--categories))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of control categories matching the filters.

<a id="nestedatt--categories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `categories`

Read-Only:

- `category_id` (String) The unique identifier of the category.
- `category_name` (String) The name of the category.
- `framework_id` (String) The framework this category belongs to.
